summary: Iteration 41 — E2E testing of Content Publishing Gateway for Crescimento Orgânico. Backend test passed (1/1). Frontend E2E via Playwright verified: Gateway section visible on /marketing with architecture summary, authorization flow works, 'Publicar agora' button publishes content after strategy approval, public pages /insights and /insights/:slug work correctly, section overrides (login.hero_headline) are applied to public pages, rollback and remove functionality work, view tracking increments metrics, analytics (campaign comparison, editorial scoring) display correctly.

site_publishing.py: Authorization flow sets site_live_owner=true and clears other owners atomically.
site_publishing.py: upsert_site_content() handles article, page, and section_override kinds with proper validation.
site_publishing.py: _compute_editorial_score() calculates score based on SEO fields, structure, hero image, and views.
site_publishing.py: maybe_publish_autonomous_site_content() integrates with organic agent and respects rate limits (max 6 articles).
site_publishing.py: Public endpoints correctly filter by site_live_owner company_id for multi-tenant isolation.
site_publishing.py: Rollback creates new version and restores previous snapshot while preserving metrics.
site_publishing.py: Logs capture action, status, previous/new content, strategy reason, keyword, and objective.
SitePublishingGatewaySection.jsx: All data-testids correctly implemented for testing.
SitePublishingGatewaySection.jsx: Stats grid shows authorization, published entries, failures, and rollbacks.
SitePublishingGatewaySection.jsx: Analytics card shows campaign comparison, editorial scoring, and creatives status.
PublicInsightsHub.jsx: Correctly fetches and displays public articles with hero images.
PublicInsightPage.jsx: Tracks views on page load and renders sections with PublicContentRenderer.
Login.jsx: Consumes section overrides from fetchPublicSections() for hero headline/subtitle.
Pricing.jsx: Consumes section overrides for hero headline/subtitle (requires auth to access).
Contact.jsx: Consumes section overrides for hero intro.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create/cleanup site_publication_settings, site_content_entries, site_content_versions, site_publication_logs, and organic agent data for isolation testing.
